card.name: "No earlier than" dose repeat spacing
card.fires_on: The word "earlier" in "no earlier than" right after a statement that a dose or treatment course may be repeated. It comes just before a time interval such as 12 hours or 3 days.

modes.label: Repeat no earlier than
modes.description: "earlier" after "repeated no" in dosing instructions, ahead of a minimum interval.
modes.example: Dose to be repeated no<< earlier>> than 3 days. Prophyl

card.writes: It promotes tokens meaning interval, short time, and immediately (mostly Chinese words), which suggests it adds a sense of spacing between doses.
card.plain: It fires on the word "earlier" when a label says a dose can be repeated no earlier than a set time.
